DayOff Mate (연차메이트)

DayOff Mate Terms of Use

Effective November 22, 2026 · Operated by JAEYOUNG LEE (blessingq)

This English version is a translation provided for convenience. If it differs from the Korean version above, the Korean version prevails.

DayOff Mate's calculations are for reference only, based on the Korean Labor Standards Act, and have no legal effect. Your actual leave may differ depending on company rules, attendance and your employment contract. Please check with your company and the Ministry of Employment and Labor help center (1350).

1. Purpose

These Terms set out the conditions for using the mobile app DayOff Mate (연차메이트, the “app” or “service”) provided by JAEYOUNG LEE (blessingq, the “developer”), and the rights and obligations of the developer and users.

2. Definitions

  • “User”: anyone who uses the app under these Terms
  • “Account”: a DayOff Mate account created by signing in with Kakao, Naver, Google or Apple (iOS)
  • “Group”: a set of users with accounts who view days off together

3. Posting and changes

The developer posts these Terms on this page and in the app, and may change them within the limits of the law. Changes are announced on this page and in the app at least 7 days before they take effect (30 days for changes unfavorable to users). If you do not agree, you may stop using the app and delete your account.

4. The service

The app provides leave calculation and records, calendar and list views, long-weekend suggestions, reminders, home widgets, backup (Google Drive and files) and phone calendar integration; if you sign in, it also provides sync and groups. All personal record features work without signing in. The service is free and may include ads.

5. Calculations are for reference only

  1. Leave days, expiry dates, length of service, long-weekend suggestions and other results are reference calculations based on what you enter and the Labor Standards Act. They have no legal effect and are not a basis for claims against your employer.
  2. Results may differ from reality because of company rules, attendance, contracts, changes in law or public holidays. They may not fit workplaces with fewer than 5 regular employees, people working under 15 hours a week, seafarers and others.
  3. The app does not give legal advice. For a definitive answer, ask your company or official help lines such as the Ministry of Employment and Labor (1350) or the Foreign Workforce Counseling Center (1577-0071).

6. Accounts

  1. Signing in is optional. You must be 14 or older to create an account.
  2. Each sign-in method creates a separate account; accounts from different methods are not merged automatically.
  3. You are responsible for your phone and sign-in account, and must not use someone else's account.

7. User obligations

You must not:

  • break the law or these Terms, or infringe others' rights;
  • impersonate others or misuse others' accounts or invite codes;
  • reverse-engineer or tamper with the app or servers, send bulk automated requests, or bypass security measures;
  • interfere with the operation of the service.

You are responsible for the accuracy of what you enter (hire date, records, etc.).

8. Group rules

  1. Nicknames and group names are visible to others. Do not use profanity, hate or discrimination, sexual content, impersonation, or personal information such as phone numbers.
  2. Do not spread other members' information outside the group without their consent, or use it to harass or monitor anyone.
  3. In company or team groups, do not use the app to pressure or disadvantage anyone for taking leave.
  4. Share invite codes and links only with the people you mean to invite.
  5. To report an inappropriate nickname, group or behavior, use Group settings > member menu > “Report” in the app, or the support page.
  6. If a violation is confirmed, the developer may ask for a nickname or group name change, remove the user from the group, restrict use, or delete the account.

9. Changes to and suspension of the service

The developer may change or end part or all of this free service. Before ending server features (sign-in, sync, groups), we will give notice 30 days in advance where possible and let you keep your records on your phone or export them to a file. The service may be interrupted temporarily for maintenance, outages or problems with external services.

10. Advertising

The app may show ads. Advertisers are responsible for their ads and for the products and services they offer.

11. Restriction and termination

  1. You can delete (terminate) your account at any time in the app under Settings > Account > Manage account > Delete account, or as described on the account deletion page.
  2. If you seriously breach these Terms or interfere with the service, the developer may restrict your use or delete your account. We will notify you in advance by email (if available) or in the app, or afterwards in urgent cases. You can object by writing to ejok9194@gmail.com.
  3. What is deleted and what is kept after account deletion is described in the Privacy Policy and on the account deletion page.

12. Limitation of liability

  1. The developer is not liable for decisions you make based on the calculations, disputes with your employer, or the consequences of taking leave.
  2. The developer is not liable for damage caused by natural disasters, network failures, or outages or policy changes of external services (Google, Kakao, Naver, Apple, carriers, etc.).
  3. The developer is not liable for loss of records caused by the user (losing a phone, uninstalling without a backup, wrong input, etc.) or for disputes between users.
  4. This does not apply to damage caused by the developer's intent or gross negligence, or where liability cannot be limited by law.

13. Intellectual property

Rights to the app, logo, design and text belong to the developer. Records and nicknames you enter are yours; the developer uses them only as needed to provide the service.

14. Governing law and jurisdiction

These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Korea. Disputes about the service are resolved in the court with jurisdiction under the Korean Civil Procedure Act.

Supplementary provisions

  • These Terms take effect on November 22, 2026.
  • These Terms are written in Korean. If the English translation differs, the Korean version prevails.
  • The terms of the app stores (Google Play, App Store) also apply.
